title: M3 Pages packaging promotion rebind verifier
purpose: Verify promotion of the frozen QA/human-approved M3 GitHub Pages browser packaging onto current main without mutating the historical candidate workflow or product semantics.
invariants: No frozen ATLAS-WP-010 product file is modified by OPS-WP-012.
The verifier runs only for the dedicated Pages promotion branch or explicit manual dispatch.
Promotion must change exactly the six ATLAS-WP-010 packaging paths relative to its PR base.
All six promotion packaging files must be byte-identical to frozenPagesHead.
All nine promoted M3 authoring foundation files must remain byte-identical to frozenAuthoringHead.
Pages/browser packaging tests, foundation tests and canonical validators must pass on the integrated promotion tree.
Generated Pages bundle must be deterministic.
The promoted learner artifact identity must remain unchanged.
Human PASS is already present; this verifier is an integration gate, not a substitute human gate.
requiredEvidence: Byte identity of all six packaging files to frozenPagesHead.
Byte identity of all nine foundation files to frozenAuthoringHead.
Learner artifact exact bytes and SHA-256 PASS.
Machine-readable evidence bound to base, frozen candidate and exact promotion head.
adversarialTests: Promotion path outside the exact six-file set.
Any frozen packaging blob differs by one byte.
Any frozen foundation blob differs by one byte.
Pages/browser test failure on the integrated tree.
Attempt to modify the historical candidate workflow to make promotion green.
nonGoals: Changing the current live human-gate deployment.
independentReview: Repository governance and PR scope must pass for OPS-WP-012.
The promotion verifier must run on the final Pages promotion HEAD before merge.
rollback: Remove the verifier workflow in a later governed cleanup after Pages promotion closeout.
